mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(m.category, '기타') AS category, SUM(wh.amount) AS amount FROM wallet_histories wh LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = wh.merchant_id WHERE wh.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wh.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND wh.status = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE_FORMAT(wh.created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY IFNULL(m.category, '기타') ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
